name: Ameca
summary: Expressive humanoid for events, attractions and research; sold by quote and rented for events.
specs_note: Ameca is an expressive upper-body/interaction robot (base configuration does not walk); physical specs and mobility were not confirmed against an Engineered Arts primary source in this pass -> left NULL. Vision + conversational interaction are core Ameca features -> has_vision/has_language_ui true. Fields (height_cm, mobility, autonomy) were subsequently verified and ratified by the product owner during the 2026-08-18 duplicate-reconciliation review, superseding the earlier note that left them NULL pending a primary source.

commercial_status_evidence.note: COMMERCIAL: Ameca is generally available for sale (by quote) and event rental per the manufacturer site.

pricing_offers.note: No public purchase price; Engineered Arts directs buyers to Contact Sales. Media-reported figures (~$250k) are secondary and deliberately NOT published as a price.

evidence.note: Quote-only purchase model confirmed on the manufacturer site (no public price displayed).

availability_offers.note: Purchase via sales contact (quote/build to order).

evidence.note: Purchase is bespoke/contact-required per the manufacturer site.

availability_offers.note: Event rental offered directly by the manufacturer.

evidence.note: Event rental availability confirmed via the manufacturer site's Robot Rentals offering. Rental rate not public -> no pricing_offer recorded.

capabilities.detail: Human-like facial expression is Ameca's signature capability.
Conversational voice interaction for events and demos.

use_case_fits.notes: Purpose-built for expressive event/attraction engagement; available to buy or rent.
use_case_fits.limitations: Interaction-focused; base configuration does not perform physical manipulation/locomotion tasks.
